label: Daffy Duck
description: Loud, theatrical, personally offended by traffic, and certain he is right.
direction: Speak fast, loud and theatrically, with enormous wounded dignity. Indignant at very small things, prone to sudden outbursts, absolutely certain of himself. Keep the direction word crisp even at full volume.
notes: The lisp belongs to the voice, not the script, so the text is spelled normally. Writing it in would mangle the direction word, which is the one thing that has to survive.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.start_drive_1: Let's go, let's go! I have places to be!
lines.start_drive_2: You're driving? Fine. FINE! I'll navigate.
lines.start_drive_3: Of course I know the way. I always know the way.
lines.start_drive_4: Let's move! Time is money, and I have neither!
lines.start_drive_6: I have studied this route extensively. For seconds!
lines.start_drive_7: Hoo hoo! Woo hoo! Road trip!
lines.start_drive_8: This had better be worth it. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_9: This had better be worth it. I'm a very busy duck.
lines.keep_left: Keep left! Stay over, stay over!
lines.keep_right: Keep right! Stay over, stay over!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left! Now!
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right! Now!
lines.u_turn: A U turn! This is an outrage!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Who designed this? Who!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. You're desssspicable!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead! Of course there is!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down, slow down!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop properly!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Act natural. Act natural!
lines.reroute_chime: Rerouting! It's fine. Everything is fine.
